wins: Completed reconnaissance tasks within expected time windows with accurate service enumeration.
Demonstrated consistent logging and reporting through each mentor interaction, ensuring traceability.
fails: Episode failed to achieve objective due to inability to exploit the identified vulnerability before session timeout.
Heavy reliance on mentor calls (15 total) indicated missed automation opportunities, lowering autonomous decision-making.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was solid, but the run stalled during exploitation and lacked autonomous offensive progression.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated failure to chain SSH credentials after enumeration completed but before time limit.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts to confirm service versions

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH credentials fail on initial connection
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke credential spraying sequence with locked retry limits

skill_cards.if_condition: When remote service enumeration has completed but no payload delivered
skill_cards.then_action: Queue privilege escalation tools with session rescue fallbacks

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying SSH services and preparing follow-up actions
